tests: a criterion naming a describe title is not proven by the suite point, even when every test inside it was skipped

consumesExternalOutput.program: node src/gates/suite.ts, the suite gate CLI, which spawns the configured node:test run and parses its reporter stream, and runs each criterion's check.command through src/criteria.ts
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Captured 2026-09-30 in the kernel container on node v26.6.0 by running the gate CLI over the fixtures test/criteria.test.ts builds (the command and exit are recorded above each block; this witness's test asserts the finding the gate prints for a describe title). The named test drives a real node:test run or a real spawned command and, where it names a block, compares the live gate stdout with it byte for byte; nothing asserted is a hand-written string standing in for another program's output.
